text:
sam: Heads-up — getting escalations from a couple customers about p95/p99 spike after we flipped the int8 quant profile for text-gen-v3 on the hosted pool. p50 looks fine, tails are ~2-3x higher. Investigating now.

amy: Ugh. Which host pool / model alias? any repro request ids?

sam: model=text-gen-v3@v2, pool=hosted-a-prod. Customer reported poor tail on long-context prompts (>512). Example request_id=rx-8f3bcd attached. Graph: https://grafana.redwood/shot/shot123 :eyes:

kevin: Could be calibration producing bad scales that force slow FP fallback paths or extra memcpy. Did we run the new calibrate job with real seq distribution?

lia: Looking at runtime logs from the worker that served rx-8f3bcd:```
kv_cache_lookup: miss (prefix len 520)
quant_dispatch: using int8_path
kernel_select: conv_v2_amx disabled for seq>512
fallback: allocate_fp16_workspace -> true
emit_latency: model_step 24ms -> 180ms
```

lia: There's also a lot of "fp16_fallback: true" lines after token 512. Seems quantized kernels aren't handling long seq well.

judy: Any change in batching config or continuous-batching thresholds around the rollout? small batches can magnify quant overhead.

sam: Not intentionally. We did flip the quant profile via rollout that targeted hosted-a-prod last night at 02:30 UTC. Batch config unchanged.

kevin: Repro checklist I'm going to run: 1) curl repro with seq=600, 2) run local perf with and w/o int8 profile, 3) capture nvprof/cupti if it repros. Repro curl:```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"text-gen-v3@v2","input":"<prompt of len ~600>","max_tokens":64}' https://api.redwood.dev/generate
```

amy: I'll open a support umbrella and notify the affected customers with temporary mitigation (rollback to fp16 or pin model-version). Assign to infra oncall if we need capacity. @infra-bot can you tag oncall?

infra-bot: @oncall-page triggered (severity=3). Pager will notify infra oncall.

lia: Quick mitigation options we can push asap: a) revert quant profile for that model on hosted-a-prod (fast, 1 min); b) add a conditional: if seq>512 force fp16 path; c) increase warmup/kv-prefetch for requests to reduce cache misses.

kevin: Still want to confirm root cause — likely quant kernel selection + calibration thresholds causing extra memcpy/convert ops for long sequences which spikes token emit time, hence p99. If it's calibration, re-running calibrate with long-context samples might fix without full rollback. But do we want a customer-facing fast fix?

sam: Let's do two-track: emergency rollback to fp16 for hosted-a-prod for text-gen-v3 to stop customer pain; parallel investigation to re-calibrate and tune kernel selection for int8 long-context.

judy: I can roll back the quant_profile flag on the model config and trigger a canary to verify. Will post deploy id.

deploy-bot: deploy started: deploy/rollback-1769998888-quant-profile -> hosted-a-prod (id: dply-77321).

lia: While rollback runs, I'm capturing a full perf trace. If anyone can run the curl repro and paste the raw latency numbers that'd help (p50/p95/p99).

kevin: Ran local perf (no rollback) against same hw image: int8: p50=22ms p95=170ms p99=230ms; fp16: p50=20ms p95=45ms p99=60ms. Repro is pretty clear.

sam: Thanks. That's consistent with customer reports.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: dply-77321 -> success.

judy: Rollback completed. I'm toggling the monitoring alert to low noise; keep watch for any further reports.

amy: Notifying customers: "We rolled back to known-stable model config while we tune the int8 calibration for long-context usage. We'll follow up with ETA for a safe re-roll." :thumbsup:

lia: Post-rollback note: p99 dropped back to baseline on hosted-a-prod. I still see a few residual higher latencies in the infra test cluster — looks like some machines have an older cuda driver that causes quant kernel fallback to be heavier. Logging infra nodes with anomalous tails.

kevin: Action items: 1) Re-run calibrate job with long-context sample set (owner=kevin) 2) Add guard in runtime to auto-fallback to fp16 for seq>512 until quant kernels are validated (owner=lia) 3) Add metric quant.path.fallback_rate and expose per-model (owner=lia) 4) Validate driver/kernel compatibility matrix and roll patch if needed (owner=infra team)

sam: Good. Add timeline: aim to get safe int8 re-roll in 72hrs after calibration + compatibility checks. If re-roll passes perf and calibration, we can slowly canary.

judy: Filing postmortem and rollout notes on the change with links to perf traces and customer tickets.

amy: For the support thread, include these repro steps and the mitigation we applied (rollback). I'll keep customers updated.

lia: FYI config snippet I propose to gate quantized path by seq len:```
quant_profile:
  enabled: true
  mode: auto
  seq_threshold: 512  # force fp16 path if request.seq > seq_threshold
  calibrate_samples: /datasets/calib_long_context.json
```

kevin: Also will try a hybrid approach: int8 for attention kernels but keep matmul in fp16 for long seq to avoid expensive conversion for larger KV tensors. Might get cost win without tail regressions.

sam: Solid. Keeping this thread as the single source for the incident. If you add files, paste links here. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
